# Assets — EVA_DBU Illustration Set

**Depends on**: 03-semantics (`visual/illustration` size scale)
**Referenced by**: 09-open-items
**Source**: [Figma — Foundations_for-AI](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI?node-id=5323-19962)

19 illustrations from the `illustration/evadbu/*` set — brand-specific to
**EVA_DBU** (see `00-overview.md` → Brand model). Self-contained — every
image is embedded as base64 directly in this file, no separate PNGs
needed.

**Need just one illustration instead of all 19?** See `illustrations/`
(same folder as this file) — one self-contained `.md` per illustration,
mapped in `illustrations/INDEX.md`.

## Size mapping against `visual/illustration` (03-semantics.md)

The requested display sizes were 60 / 80 / 120px. Checked against the
`visual/illustration` semantic scale (`03-semantics.md` → resolves to
`01-primitives.md` → `size`):

| Requested | Token | Scale value | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60px | — | — | **No exact token.** Nearest are `xs` (`size/6xl` = 48px) and `sm` (`size/7xl` = 64px). Neither is 60px. |
| 80px | `md` | `size/8xl` = 80px | ✅ Exact |
| 120px | `xl` | `size/10xl` = 120px | ✅ Exact |

**Open item**: 60px doesn't exist anywhere in the token scale. Logged in
`09-open-items.md` — resolve by either using the nearest token (`sm`/64px)
or adding a new step to the `size` primitive scale if 60px is a hard
product requirement. Illustrations below are still rendered at 60px as
originally requested, labeled as off-scale.

## Notes

- Most sources are raster image fills capped at their native export
  resolution (mostly 80×80); 120px display is an upscale from that source
  and may look soft on high-density displays — this is a source-asset
  limit, not a documentation gap.
- `branchtransfer` (120×80) and `ekyc` (120×112) are not square natively;
  square display sizes above will stretch them slightly.
